name: AMEGA-LLM
intro: AMEGA-LLM以临床指南为依据，由资深医生构建跨13个医学专业的20个虚构病例、135个顺序开放问题和1337个加权评分元素。候选模型接受零样本口试，GPT-4-0613逐准则判断，并通过条件重问、11次并行多数投票和加权汇总评估指南依从性。
org: DATEXIS, Beuth University of Applied Sciences Berlin
build_method: 现行临床指南选取, 资深医生病例与问题编写, 加权准则及同行复核
metric: 加权指南依从分, 50分病例均值, 归一化缺陷与成本
eval_feature: 零样本临床口试, GPT-4逐准则评估, 条件重问, 11次多数投票
scale: 20个诊断场景，135个问题，1337个评估标准
build_method_en: Current guideline selection, experienced-physician case and question authoring, weighted rubrics and peer review
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot clinical oral exam, criterion-level GPT-4 judging, conditional reasks, 11-run majority voting
intro_en: AMEGA-LLM is grounded in clinical guidelines and was built by experienced physicians as 20 fictional cases across 13 specialties, 135 sequential open-ended questions, and 1,337 weighted scoring elements. Candidate models take a zero-shot oral exam; GPT-4-0613 checks every criterion, followed by conditional reasks, 11 parallel majority votes, and weighted aggregation of guideline adherence.
scale_en: 20 diagnostic scenarios, 135 questions, 1337 weighted scoring elements
metric_en: Weighted guideline-adherence score, 50-point case mean, normalized deficiencies and cost
drawio_review_note: CORRECTED against Nature DOI 10.1038/s41746-024-01356-6, Methods pp. 9-12: Dataset and benchmark design, Benchmark structure and evaluation methodology, Reask process, Scoring system, and Evaluation method / Self-consistency, plus the official DATEXIS/AMEGA-benchmark repository. The paper snapshot remains 20 cases, 135 questions, and 1,337 weighted elements; the repository later reports 24 cases, 163 questions, and 1,497 criteria. Each of 11 attempts returns one Boolean vector for all criteria. An attempt is malformed only when its Boolean count differs from the criterion count; more than 50% malformed attempts trigger criteria-list bisection and a fresh 11-attempt evaluation of each half. Valid vectors proceed to per-criterion majority vote and confidence, then conditional Reask or weighted 50-point scoring. Evaluator validation is a separate study.
